newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK WORKERS' REAL DISPOSABLE INCOME FELL 30PCT IN 92-96.
newsitem.headline: GREEK WORKERS' REAL DISPOSABLE INCOME FELL 30PCT IN 92-96.

text.p: The real disposable income of Greek income earners was reduced by 30 percent in the period 1992-96 because of bracket creep, conservative New Democracy party said.

The consumer price index rose 50 percent on average between 1992-96, nominal incomes increased by less than that and personal income taxes for small and medium salaried workers rose up to 100 percent reducing their disposable income by up to 30 percent, it said.
Real disposable income is equal to personal after tax income adjusted for inflation.
New Democracy asked for the indexation of tax scale to CPI inflation and presented an amendment to the existing tax law, it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
